name: Kafa Ƙungiya Marar Riba a California, Har da Kuɗaɗen da Ake Kashewa
objectives: Idan aka ba ku matakan kafa ƙungiyar agaji a California, jera manyan takardun kafawa a jere da ofishin da ke kula da kowacce, kowace takarda a jerin da ya dace
Idan aka ba ku manufar ƙungiyarku, zaɓar fom ɗin takardar kafa kamfani da ya dace da shirya Statement of Information, da wurin shigarwa da ranakun ƙarshe daidai

Bayan an karɓi takardar kafa kamfaninku, samun lambar EIN kyauta a irs.gov da shirya taron farko na kwamitin gudanarwa, lambobin sirri a shafin IRS na hukuma kaɗai, kuma an jera kowane hukunci na taron farko
Ta amfani da takardar duba cancanta ta IRS, zaɓi tsakanin fom 1023 da fom 1023-EZ da faɗin inda ake shigar da shi, da kuɗin da aka ɗauko daga shafin hukuma
Bayan amincewar tarayya ko gudummawarku ta farko, shirya keɓewa daga Franchise Tax Board da rajista a Registry na Babban Lauyan Gwamnati, da fom ɗin da ya dace da wa'adin kwana 30 na Registry
Idan aka ba ku kuɗaɗe da ranakun ƙarshe da aka duba, yin kasafin kuɗin farawa da kalandar takardun shekara-shekara, kowane kuɗi da ranar ƙarshe an duba su a shafin hukuma

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Taswirar hanya: abin da ƙungiya marar riba ke buƙata a California
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Jera manyan takardun kafawa a jere da ofishin da ke kula da kowacce.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku matakan kafa ƙungiyar agaji a California, za ku iya jera manyan takardun kafawa a jere da ofishin da ke kula da kowacce, kowace takarda a jerin da ya dace.
A California, ƙungiyar agaji yawanci tana zama nonprofit public benefit corporation (kamfani marar riba na amfanin jama'a). Zama kamfani marar riba al'amari ne na jiha. Keɓewa daga haraji wani mataki ne daban: sau ɗaya wurin IRS (tarayya), sau ɗaya kuma wurin Franchise Tax Board (jiha). Ƙungiyoyin agaji da ke tara kuɗi kuma suna yin rajista wurin Babban Lauyan Gwamnati.
Jerin da aka saba shi ne: 1) zaɓar manufarku, sunanku da kwamitin gudanarwa na farko; 2) shigar da takardar kafa kamfani wurin Sakataren Gwamnati; 3) samun lambar EIN daga IRS; 4) amincewa da dokokin cikin gida (bylaws) da yin taron farko na kwamiti; 5) shigar da Statement of Information; 6) neman matsayin 501(c)(3) na tarayya; 7) neman keɓewar California wurin Franchise Tax Board; 8) yin rajista a Registry of Charities na Babban Lauyan Gwamnati.
Bin wannan jeri yana da muhimmanci. Misali, IRS tana gaya wa kamfanoni su yi rajista da jiha kafin su nemi EIN, kuma Babban Lauyan Gwamnati yana neman takardar kafa kamfaninku da dokokin cikin gida idan kuna rajista.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku rubuta manufarku cikin jimla ɗaya ko biyu.
- Ku zaɓi mutum uku ko fiye don kwamitin gudanarwa na farko, idan za ku iya.
- Ku rubuta matakai takwas ɗin a jere a shafi ɗaya.
- Kusa da kowane mataki, ku rubuta ofishin: Sakataren Gwamnati, IRS, Franchise Tax Board ko Babban Lauyan Gwamnati.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Nonprofit public benefit corporation: irin kamfanin California da yawancin ƙungiyoyin agaji ke amfani da shi; yana hidimar jama'a, ba masu shi ba.
- 501(c)(3): sashen dokar harajin tarayya na ƙungiyoyin agaji; gudummawa gare su yawanci ana iya cire ta daga haraji.
- Keɓewa daga haraji (tax-exempt): rashin wajabcin biyan harajin kuɗin shiga, bayan wata hukuma ta amince.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Sakataren Gwamnatin California (Secretary of State): fom da kuɗin rajistar kamfanonin California (da Turanci)
- IRS: Samun lambar EIN (Employer Identification Number, da Turanci)
- Franchise Tax Board na California: ƙungiyoyin agaji da marasa riba (fom 3500 / 3500A, da Turanci)
- Babban Lauyan Gwamnatin California (Attorney General): Registry of Charities, rajistar farko (CT-1, da Turanci)
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta manufar ƙungiyarku cikin jimla ɗaya ko biyu. Sannan ku rubuta matakai takwas na kafawa a jere da ofishin kowanne. Ku ajiye wannan shafi: shi ne zai zama shirin kafawarku na ƙarshe.
Yanzu za ku iya jera takardun kafa ƙungiya marar riba a California a jere da faɗin ofishin da ke kula da kowacce.

check.q: Wane ofishi ne ke kula da keɓewa daga harajin California?
check.why: Keɓewa daga haraji tana wurin IRS (tarayya) da Franchise Tax Board (jiha).

check.q: Wani mai kafawa yana son neman EIN kafin ya shigar da takardar kafa kamfani. Me za ku gaya masa?
options: Ya fara shigar da takardar kafa kamfani wurin Sakataren Gwamnati, kamar yadda IRS ke gaya wa kamfanoni
Ya fara rajista wurin Babban Lauyan Gwamnati
check.why: IRS tana gaya wa kamfanoni su yi rajista da jiha kafin su nemi EIN.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Shigar da takardar kafa kamfani
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Zaɓar fom ɗin takardar kafa kamfani da ya dace da shigar da shi wurin Sakataren Gwamnati.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku manufar ƙungiyarku, za ku iya zaɓar fom ɗin takardar kafa kamfani da ya dace da shirya Statement of Information, da wurin shigarwa da ranakun ƙarshe daidai.
Takardar kafa kamfani (articles of incorporation) ita ce ke kafa kamfaninku. Sakataren Gwamnatin California yana da nau'i uku na ƙungiyoyi marasa riba: fom ARTS-PB (amfanin jama'a), fom ARTS-RE (addini) da fom ARTS-MU (amfanin membobi). Kuɗin shigar da kowanne $30 ne lokacin da muka duba.
Yawancin ƙungiyoyin agaji suna amfani da na amfanin jama'a. Coci ko hidimar addini na iya amfani da fom na addini. Na amfanin membobi na ƙungiyoyin da ke hidimar membobinsu ne, kamar wasu kulob-kulob, kuma bai dace da yawancin ƙungiyoyin agaji ba. Idan kuna shirin neman matsayin 501(c)(3), IRS tana buƙatar wasu kalmomi a takardar kafa kamfaninku game da manufarku da abin da zai faru da kadarorinku idan kun rufe. Ku karanta umarnin fom ɗin, kuma ku nemi lauyan ƙungiyoyi marasa riba ko cibiyar taimako ya duba shi.
Kuna iya shigar da shi ta intanet a bizfile Online (bizfileonline.sos.ca.gov), ko ta wasiƙa, ko da kanku a ofis. Ku fara bincika sunan don ku tabbata ba wanda ke amfani da shi. Cikin kwana 90, kuna kuma shigar da Statement of Information (fom SI-100, $20), sannan kuma bayan kowace shekara biyu.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku bincika sunanku a bizfile Online.
- Ku zaɓi fom: ARTS-PB ga yawancin ƙungiyoyin agaji, ARTS-RE ga ƙungiyoyin addini.
- Ku cike shi da sunanku, manufarku da wakilin karɓar takardun shari'a.
- Ku shigar da shi ta intanet ku biya kuɗin da ke shafin hukuma.
- Ku sa Statement of Information (SI-100) a kalandarku: cikin kwana 90, sannan bayan kowace shekara biyu.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Takardar kafa kamfani (articles of incorporation): gajeriyar takarda da ke kafa kamfaninku a shari'ance.
- Wakilin karɓar takardun shari'a (agent for service of process): mutum ko kamfanin da ya yarda ya karɓi takardun shari'a a madadin ƙungiyar.
- Statement of Information: fom da ke gaya wa jiha adireshinku da shugabanninku; ƙungiyoyi marasa riba suna shigar da SI-100.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Sakataren Gwamnatin California (Secretary of State): fom da kuɗin rajistar kamfanonin California (da Turanci)
- Sakataren Gwamnatin California: Statement of Information (SI-100 na ƙungiyoyi marasa riba, da Turanci)
- Sakataren Gwamnatin California: bizfile Online (da Turanci)
Gwada yanzu: Ku buɗe shafin fom na Sakataren Gwamnati. Ku nemo fom ɗin takardar kafa kamfani da ya dace da ƙungiyarku, ku rubuta sunan fom ɗin da kuɗinsa na yanzu. Sannan ku nemo kuɗin SI-100 ku ƙara dukkansu a shirinku tare da ranar ƙarshe ta SI-100.
Yanzu za ku iya zaɓar fom ɗin takardar kafa kamfani da ya dace, nemo kuɗinsa a shafin hukuma, da sa Statement of Information a kalanda.

check.q: Wane fom na takardar kafa kamfani ne bai dace da yawancin ƙungiyoyin agaji ba?
check.why: Na amfanin membobi na ƙungiyoyin da ke hidimar membobinsu ne, kuma bai dace da yawancin ƙungiyoyin agaji ba.

check.q: Kuna son sa wa ƙungiyarku suna "Hope Kitchen." Me za ku yi kafin ku shigar da takarda?
options: Ku tambayi AI ko sunan ba a amfani da shi
Ku biya wani shafin intanet ya ajiye muku shi
Ku fara bincika sunan don ku tabbata ba wanda ke amfani da shi
check.why: Ku fara bincika sunan don ku tabbata ba wanda ke amfani da shi.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Samun EIN, dokokin cikin gida da taron farko na kwamiti
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Samun EIN kyauta lafiya da shirya taron farko na kwamitin gudanarwa.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Bayan an karɓi takardar kafa kamfaninku, za ku iya samun lambar EIN kyauta a irs.gov da shirya taron farko na kwamitin gudanarwa, lambobin sirri a shafin IRS na hukuma kaɗai, kuma an jera kowane hukunci na taron farko.
EIN (Employer Identification Number) ita ce lambar harajin tarayya ta ƙungiyar. Kuna buƙatar ta don asusun banki, biyan albashi da takardun neman keɓewa daga haraji. IRS ta ce ba dole ne ku taɓa biyan kuɗi don EIN ba. Wasu shafukan intanet suna karɓar kuɗi a kanta: ku guje su, ku nema a irs.gov.
Kayan aikin IRS na intanet yana buƙatar lambar Social Security ko ITIN ta mutumin da ke da alhaki (responsible party), kuma dole a gama shi a zama ɗaya. Ku rubuta waɗannan lambobin sirri a shafin IRS na hukuma kaɗai, ba a kayan AI, imel ko wani shafi kawai ba. Ku buga ko ajiye wasiƙar tabbatarwa.
Dokokin cikin gida (bylaws) su ne ƙa'idodinku: yawan daraktoci, yadda ake zaɓensu, yadda tarurruka ke tafiya, da wanda ke sa hannu a cak. A taron farko na kwamiti, kwamitin yana amincewa da dokokin cikin gida, yana zaɓar shugabanni, yana amincewa da buɗe asusun banki, kuma yana amincewa da ƙa'idar rikicin muradu (conflict-of-interest policy). Ku rubuta bayanin taron (minutes) ku ajiye shi.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku jira har Sakataren Gwamnati ya karɓi takardar kafa kamfaninku.
- Ku je irs.gov ku nemi EIN da kayan aikin intanet na kyauta.
- Ku ajiye wasiƙar tabbatar da EIN a fayil ɗin takardunku.
- Ku rubuta daftarin dokokin cikin gida da ƙa'idar rikicin muradu.
- Ku yi taron farko na kwamiti ku rubuta bayanin taron.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- EIN: Employer Identification Number: lambar harajin tarayya ta kyauta ga ƙungiya.
- Dokokin cikin gida (bylaws): rubutattun ƙa'idodin yadda ƙungiyar da kwamitinta ke gudana.
- Bayanin taro (minutes): rubutaccen tarihin abin da kwamiti ya yanke a taro.
- Ƙa'idar rikicin muradu (conflict-of-interest policy): ƙa'idodin abin da memban kwamiti dole ya yi idan wani hukunci zai iya amfanar shi da kansa.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- IRS: Samun lambar EIN (Employer Identification Number, da Turanci)
Gwada yanzu: Ku yi ajandar taron farko mai abubuwa biyar: amincewa da dokokin cikin gida, zaɓar shugabanni, amincewa da asusun banki, amincewa da ƙa'idar rikicin muradu, da sa ranar taro na gaba. Ku ƙara "Neman EIN a irs.gov (kyauta)" a shirinku tare da rana bayan an karɓi takardar kafa kamfaninku.
Yanzu za ku iya samun EIN lafiya kuma kyauta, da gudanar da taron farko na kwamiti da hukunce-hukuncen da suka dace a ajanda.

options: Asusun banki, biyan albashi da takardun neman keɓewa daga haraji
check.why: EIN ita ce lambar harajin tarayya ta ƙungiyar don banki, albashi da neman keɓewa.

check.q: Kuna cike kayan aikin EIN na IRS a intanet kuma kuna buƙatar tsayawa a tsakiya. Me ya kamata ku sani?
options: Kuna iya ajiyewa ku gama mako mai zuwa
Dole a gama shi a zama ɗaya
AI zai iya gama muku shi
Kuna iya aika sauran ga IRS ta imel
check.why: Dole a gama kayan aikin IRS na intanet a zama ɗaya.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Keɓewa daga haraji, rajista da kuɗaɗe

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Neman matsayin 501(c)(3) na tarayya
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Zaɓi tsakanin fom 1023 da fom 1023-EZ da sanin kuɗin.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da takardar duba cancanta ta IRS, za ku iya zaɓi tsakanin fom 1023 da fom 1023-EZ da faɗin inda ake shigar da shi, da kuɗin da aka ɗauko daga shafin hukuma.
Don zama ƙungiyar agaji ta 501(c)(3), yawancin ƙungiyoyi suna nema wurin IRS. Akwai fom biyu. Fom 1023 shi ne cikakken takardar nema; kuɗinsa $600 ne lokacin da muka duba. Fom 1023-EZ gajeren fom ne na ƙananan ƙungiyoyi; kuɗinsa $275 ne. Ana shigar da dukkansu ta intanet a Pay.gov, kuma ana biyan kuɗin a can lokacin da kuke shigarwa.
Ba kowa ne zai iya amfani da 1023-EZ ba. IRS tana da takardar duba cancanta (eligibility worksheet) a ƙarshen umarnin fom 1023-EZ. Tana duba abubuwa kamar yawan kuɗin da kuke sa ran tarawa da kadarorinku. Ku cike takardar da gaskiya kafin ku zaɓa.
Coci-coci suna da dokoki na musamman: IRS tana ɗaukar coci-coci daban da sauran ƙungiyoyin agaji, kuma da yawa ba dole ne su nema ba, ko da yake wasu suna zaɓar nema. Ku karanta IRS Publication 1828 ko ku tambayi ƙwararre. Idan IRS ta amince da ku, tana aiko da wasiƙar amincewa (determination letter). Ku ajiye ta har abada: masu ba da gudummawa, masu ba da tallafi (grant) da jiha za su nema.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku buɗe umarnin fom 1023-EZ a irs.gov ku cike takardar duba cancanta.
- Idan kun cancanta kuma ya dace, ku shirya 1023-EZ; idan ba haka ba, ku shirya fom 1023.
- Ku buɗe asusu a Pay.gov ku cike fom ɗin a can.
- Ku biya kuɗin da ke shafin kuɗaɗen IRS.
- Ku ajiye wasiƙar amincewa idan ta iso.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Fom 1023: cikakken takardar neman matsayin 501(c)(3) na IRS.
- Fom 1023-EZ: gajeriyar takardar nema ta IRS ga ƙananan ƙungiyoyin da suka ci takardar duba cancanta.
- Kuɗin nema (user fee): kuɗin da IRS ke karɓa don duba takardar nema.
- Wasiƙar amincewa (determination letter): wasiƙar IRS da ke cewa an keɓe ƙungiyarku daga haraji.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- IRS: Kuɗin fom 1023 da 1023-EZ (da Turanci)
- IRS: Game da fom 1023 (da Turanci)
- IRS: Game da fom 1023-EZ (takardar duba cancanta tana cikin umarnin, da Turanci)
- IRS Publication 1828: Jagorar haraji ga coci-coci da ƙungiyoyin addini (da Turanci)
Gwada yanzu: Ku buɗe umarnin fom 1023-EZ a irs.gov ku karanta takardar duba cancanta. Ku yanke wane fom ne ƙungiyarku za ta shigar, sannan ku ƙara wannan fom, kuɗin daga shafin kuɗaɗen IRS, da ranar da kuke nufi a shirinku.
Yanzu za ku iya zaɓi tsakanin fom 1023 da 1023-EZ, nemo kuɗin na yanzu, da sanin inda ake shigar da shi.

check.q: Yaushe ake biyan kuɗin IRS na fom 1023 ko 1023-EZ?
options: A Pay.gov lokacin da kuke shigarwa
check.why: Ana shigar da dukkan fom biyun ta intanet a Pay.gov, kuma ana biyan kuɗin a can lokacin shigarwa.

check.q: IRS ta aiko da wasiƙar amincewarku. Me za ku yi da ita?
options: Ku jefar da ita bayan shekara ɗaya
Ku ba wani mai gudummawa kwafin da kuke da shi kaɗai
Ku ajiye ta har abada, domin masu gudummawa, masu ba da tallafi da jiha za su nema
check.why: Ku ajiye wasiƙar amincewa har abada; mutane da yawa za su nema.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Keɓewar California da Registry of Charities
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Shirya keɓewa daga Franchise Tax Board da rajista wurin Babban Lauyan Gwamnati.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Bayan amincewar tarayya ko gudummawarku ta farko, za ku iya shirya keɓewa daga Franchise Tax Board da rajista a Registry na Babban Lauyan Gwamnati, da fom ɗin da ya dace da wa'adin kwana 30 na Registry.
Amincewar tarayya kaɗai ba ta keɓe ku daga harajin California ba. Kuna kuma nema wurin Franchise Tax Board (FTB). Fom 3500 shi ne cikakken takardar nema ta California. Fom 3500A gajeren fom ne ga ƙungiyoyin da suka riga suka sami wasiƙar amincewa ta IRS. Ku duba ftb.ca.gov don fom na yanzu, umarni da kowane kuɗi kafin ku shigar, domin ba mu iya tabbatar da kuɗin a shafin FTB don wannan kwas ba.
Ƙungiyoyin agaji da ke riƙe ko tara kuɗi don ayyukan agaji a California suna kuma yin rajista a Registry of Charities na Babban Lauyan Gwamnati. Kuna yin rajista ta intanet da fom CT-1 cikin kwana 30 bayan kun fara karɓar kadarorin agaji, kamar gudummawarku ta farko. Kuɗin $50 ne lokacin da muka duba. Kuna loda takardar kafa kamfaninku, dokokin cikin gida, wasiƙar amincewa ta IRS (ko EIN ɗinku idan ba ku da wasiƙar tukuna) da fom 1023 ko 1023-EZ idan kun shigar da ɗaya.
Wasu ƙungiyoyi na iya zama an keɓe su daga rajistar Registry. Idan kuna tsammanin naku yana cikinsu (misali, ƙungiyar addini), ku karanta shafukan Registry ko ku tambayi Registry kafin ku tsallake shi.
Mataki-mataki:
- Bayan wasiƙar IRS ta iso, ku shirya fom 3500A a ftb.ca.gov (ko fom 3500 idan kuna nema ba tare da ita ba).
- Ku rubuta ranar da kuka fara karɓar gudummawa ko wata kadarar agaji.
- Cikin kwana 30 daga wannan rana, ku yi rajista ta intanet da fom CT-1.
- Ku loda takardar kafa kamfani, dokokin cikin gida, wasiƙar IRS ko EIN, da 1023 ko 1023-EZ ɗinku.
- Ku biya kuɗin Registry da ke oag.ca.gov.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Franchise Tax Board (FTB): hukumar harajin jihar California.
- Fom 3500A: gajeren fom na keɓewar California ga ƙungiyoyin da suka riga suka sami wasiƙar 501(c)(3) ta tarayya.
- Registry of Charities: ofishin Babban Lauyan Gwamnati da ke yi wa ƙungiyoyin agaji rajista kuma yana sa ido a kansu a California.
- CT-1: fom ɗin rajistar farko na ƙungiyoyin agaji na Babban Lauyan Gwamnati.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Franchise Tax Board na California: ƙungiyoyin agaji da marasa riba (fom 3500 / 3500A, da Turanci)
- Babban Lauyan Gwamnatin California (Attorney General): Registry of Charities, rajistar farko (CT-1, da Turanci)
Gwada yanzu: Ku ƙara layuka biyu a shirinku: keɓewar FTB (sunan fom, "duba kuɗi a ftb.ca.gov", ranar da kuke nufi bayan wasiƙar IRS) da CT-1 na Babban Lauyan Gwamnati ($50, cikin kwana 30 bayan gudummawarku ta farko). Ku yi jerin takardu huɗu da za ku loda.
Yanzu za ku iya shirya keɓewarku daga harajin California da rajistarku a Registry of Charities da fom, lokaci da takardun da suka dace.

check.q: Wane fom ne cikakken takardar neman keɓewar California?
check.why: Fom 3500 shi ne cikakken nema na California; 3500A shi ne gajere.

check.q: Hidimar addininku tana tsammanin an keɓe ta daga rajistar Registry. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku tsallake ba tare da dubawa ba
Ku karanta shafukan Registry ko ku tambayi Registry kafin ku tsallake
Ku yi rajista wurin IRS a maimakon haka
check.why: Ku duba shafukan Registry ko ku tambayi Registry kafin ku tsallake rajista.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Ci gaba a kyakkyawan matsayi da kasafin kuɗin kafawa
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Yin kasafin kuɗin farawa da kalandar takardun shekara-shekara.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku kuɗaɗe da ranakun ƙarshe da aka duba, za ku iya yin kasafin kuɗin farawa da kalandar takardun shekara-shekara, kowane kuɗi da ranar ƙarshe an duba su a shafin hukuma.
Farawa ba shi ne ƙarshe ba. Kowace shekara kuna shigar da takarda wurin IRS: ƙananan ƙungiyoyin da kuɗin shigarsu (gross receipts) yawanci $50,000 ko ƙasa da haka suna iya shigar da fom 990-N e-Postcard; manya kuma suna shigar da fom 990-EZ ko 990. Idan kun rasa shekara uku a jere, IRS tana cire keɓewarku daga haraji kai tsaye.
Kowace shekara kuma kuna sabunta rajista wurin Babban Lauyan Gwamnati da fom RRF-1. Kuɗin ya dogara da jimillar kuɗin shiga: lokacin da muka duba, $25 ne ƙasa da $50,000, $50 daga $50,000 zuwa $100,000, $75 kuma daga $100,001 zuwa $250,000, yana ƙaruwa ga manyan ƙungiyoyi. Ranar ƙarshensa wata 4 da kwana 15 ne bayan shekarar kuɗinku ta ƙare (15 ga Mayu idan shekararku ta ƙare 31 ga Disamba). Kuna kuma da Statement of Information bayan kowace shekara biyu, da takardun shekara-shekara na California wurin FTB: ku duba ftb.ca.gov don fom ɗin da ya dace da ku.
Kuɗaɗen gwamnati na farawa, kamar yadda aka duba: takardar kafa kamfani $30, Statement of Information $20, EIN kyauta, IRS $275 (1023-EZ) ko $600 (1023), Registry $50, da kowane kuɗin FTB. Wannan kusan $375 ne da 1023-EZ ko $700 da fom 1023, kafin kowane kuɗin FTB, sabis na wakili mai rajista (registered agent) ko lauya. Ku yi amfani da AI don taimakon rubuta teburin kasafi ko jerin tunatarwa, amma ku duba kowace lamba a shafin hukuma.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku jera kowane kuɗin farawa daga shafukan hukuma.
- Ku haɗa su bisa zaɓin fom ɗinku (1023-EZ ko 1023).
- Ku ƙara takardun shekara-shekara: jerin 990 na IRS, RRF-1 na Babban Lauyan Gwamnati, takardar shekara ta FTB.
- Ku ƙara Statement of Information bayan kowace shekara biyu.
- Ku sa kowace ranar ƙarshe a kalandar da ake rabawa tare da tunatarwa biyu.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Fom 990-N: e-Postcard na IRS: gajeren sanarwa ta intanet ta shekara-shekara ga ƙananan ƙungiyoyin da aka keɓe.
- RRF-1: fom ɗin sabunta rajista na shekara-shekara na ƙungiyoyin agaji wurin Babban Lauyan Gwamnati.
- Shekarar kuɗi (fiscal year): lokacin wata 12 da ƙungiyarku ke amfani da shi don littattafan kuɗinta, sau da yawa daga Janairu zuwa Disamba.
- Kyakkyawan matsayi (good standing): kasancewa a kan lokaci da dukkan takardu da kuɗaɗen da ake buƙata.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- IRS: Fom 990-N (e-Postcard) na ƙananan ƙungiyoyin da aka keɓe daga haraji (da Turanci)
- Babban Lauyan Gwamnatin California: Registry of Charities, sabunta rajista ta shekara (RRF-1, da Turanci)
- Sakataren Gwamnatin California: Statement of Information (SI-100 na ƙungiyoyi marasa riba, da Turanci)
- IRS: Kuɗin fom 1023 da 1023-EZ (da Turanci)
- Sakataren Gwamnatin California (Secretary of State): fom da kuɗin rajistar kamfanonin California (da Turanci)
- Babban Lauyan Gwamnatin California (Attorney General): Registry of Charities, rajistar farko (CT-1, da Turanci)
- Franchise Tax Board na California: ƙungiyoyin agaji da marasa riba (fom 3500 / 3500A, da Turanci)
Gwada yanzu: Aikin ƙarshe: ku kammala shirin kafawarku na shafi ɗaya. Ku yi tebur mai kowace takarda a jere, ofishin, fom ɗin, kuɗin daga shafin hukuma, da ranar da kuke nufi. Ku ƙara takardun shekara-shekara da ranakun ƙarshensu, jimillar kuɗin farawa, da hanyar haɗin hukuma ta kowane layi.
Yanzu za ku iya yin cikakken shirin kafa ƙungiya marar riba a California mai kuɗaɗe da kalandar shekara da ke riƙe ƙungiyar a kyakkyawan matsayi.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Takardu a jere Wata takarda ta ɓace ko ba ta cikin jerin da ya dace. An jera kowace takardar kafawa a jerin da ya dace tare da ofishinta. An rubuta dalilin da yasa jerin yake da muhimmanci a aƙalla matakai biyu. Fom ɗin da suka dace An ambaci fom ɗin da bai dace ba, kamar takardar amfanin membobi ga ƙungiyar agaji. Kowace takarda tana da sunan fom ɗin da ya dace, har da takardar kafa kamfani, SI-100, 1023 ko 1023-EZ, 3500 ko 3500A, da CT-1. An bayyana zaɓin tsakanin 1023 da 1023-EZ ta amfani da takardar duba cancanta. Kuɗaɗen hukuma da hanyoyin haɗi An yi hasashen wani kuɗi ko babu hanyar haɗi. Kowane kuɗi ya fito daga shafin hukuma, da hanyar haɗi, kuma an haɗa jimillar kuɗin farawa. An rubuta ranar da aka duba kowane kuɗi. Ranakun da aka shirya Babu ranakun shigarwa da aka shirya, ko an rasa wa'adin kwana 30 na Registry da kwana 90 na SI-100. Akwai ranar da aka shirya ga kowace takarda da ta cika kowane wa'adi. An ambaci wanda ke cikin kwamiti da ke da alhakin kowace takarda. Kalandar shekara Takardun shekara-shekara sun ɓace. Takardar shekara ta IRS, RRF-1, Statement of Information na kowace shekara biyu da takardun FTB, tare da ranakun ƙarshe. An sa ranakun ƙarshe a matsayin tunatarwar kalanda ga kwamiti. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku gyara wannan sashe ku sake gwadawa.
